@@ Architecture
@stat: In
@description:
  This skill provides a bonus for designing buildings, reading or blueprints
  and technical diagrams, and evaluating or appraising tures. This skill may
  also provide a bonus for locating hidden within a structure.

@@ Diagnostics
@stat: Em
@description:
  This skill provides a bonus for determining medical condition of creature.
  Skill must be learned for a particular race, or type of creature. One must
  pick the skill in either general diagnosis, or diagnosis specific race.
  General diagnostics skill of 6 ranks or higher certification of simple
  medical practice on all races (use of field ment and healing drugs).
  Diagnostics skill for a specific race of 12 or higher is required for
  surgical certification (and reasonable tence).

@@ Dowsing
@stat: In
@description:
  This skill provides a bonus for locating underground water through the
  ground. The water will be directly under your feet when skill has
  successfully been used.

@@ Drowsing
@stat: SD

@@ Engineering
@stat: In
@description:
  This skill provides a bonus for knowing major facts about engineering of
  the appropriate technical level known to the culture. Also provides bonus
  for attempts to utilize that knowledge in new engineering projects. A GM
  may require different types of Engineering to be treated as skills.

@@ Mechanition

  exists. It will be necessary to have the appropriate skills the machine.
  Each type of machine must be learned as a separate

@@ Military Organization
@stat: In
@description:
  This skill provides a bonus for organization of a military force, actual
  deployment into battle (which is tactics). Includes knowledge how to billet
  and supply a unit, posting of watch, running of patrols,  The following is
  a partial listing of types of military organization: •Aerial Forces: Air
  Cav, aerial assault forces, etc. •Ground Forces: Infantry, cavalry, or
  other similar types of •Marine Forces: Marine, Merchant Marine or other
  similar •Naval Forces: Sea, Ocean, or other similar water type units.

@@ Mining
@stat: In
@description:
  This skill provides a bonus for assessing the possibilities of mining an
  area, and supervising the creation and running of the mine. Each of mining
  process must be learned as separate skill.  The following is a partial
  listing of mining process: • Dredging: Scraping material off the bottom of
  a river, ocean, • Open Pit: Removal of top layers to extract materials. •
  Quarry: Removal of materials in block form. • Tunneling: Making of
  underground passages to extract materials.

@@ Second Aid
@stat: Em
@description:
  This skill provides a bonus for performing minor surgery, including sewing
  closed wounds, removing diseased or mangled limbs, bone and any other minor
  surgery operation.

@@ Surgery
@stat: Em
@description:
  This skill provides a bonus for performing major surgery, includes
  performing exploratory surgery, organ transplants, acupuncture, and organ
  and limb repairs. Use of this skill is done with simple equipment (e.g.,
  scalpel, anesthesia, hemostats, respirators etc.).  Rolemaster Standard
  Rules 204

@@ Navigation
@stat: Re
@description:
  This skill provides a bonus for determining proper directions distances
  when using a map in conjunction with various directional aids, in such as a
  compass, sextant, clock, etc. This includes the concept type orienting, and
  is applicable on land, water or the stars. Note that this is far more
  precise and complex than Orienteering.

@@ Preparing Herbs
@stat: Ag
@description:
  etc. This skill provides a bonus to successfully prepare a medicinal herb
  from its natural state into a usable form.

@@ Preparing Poisons
@stat: SD
@description:
  This skill provides a bonus to successfully prepare a poison from natural
  state into a usable form.  setting

@@ Siege Engineering
@stat: Re
@description:
  Allows the user knowledge of conducting all aspects of a siege. Includes
  proper and best positioning of siege weapons, determining which weaker
  portions of a wall (for siege weapon assault and/or sapping), basic
  engineering knowledge for building ramps, digging trenches and horse traps
  (for opposing cavalry), etc.

@@ Tactics
@stat: Re
@description:
  These skills provide bonuses for perceiving and planning appropriate and
  effective strategy in tactical military situations. Skill with each
  tactical situation must be developed separately.  The following is a
  partials listing of types of tactics: • Battle Field: Cavalry and infantry
  tactics. • Naval: Ship and boat tactics. • Sabotage: Underground/behind
  enemy lines tactics. • Siege: Reduction of fortified position tactics. •
  Small Unit: Conflict between small groups.
